name: version-log
title: Version log
description: Animated version history: the rail draws and dots pop as releases scroll in, entries slide in one by one, releases fold open, with a version jump strip and a kind filter.
htmlExample:
<bef-version-log class="w-full max-w-xl" :releases='[
  {"version":"1.2.0","date":"2026-10-10","title":"Dark mode","entries":[{"kind":"added","text":"Dark mode everywhere"},{"kind":"fixed","text":"Sidebar flicker"}]},
  {"version":"1.1.0","date":"2026-09-01","entries":[{"kind":"changed","text":"Faster tables"},{"kind":"removed","text":"Old export"}]}]'></bef-version-log>
